questions.stem_text:
The construction of large-scale features, such as mounds and shell middens, is often taken
by archaeologists as evidence of:

options.D: the shift from Paleolithic to Neolithic.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - social and political complexity.

questions.stem_text: The pharaoh ruled a population of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, of which \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ were farmers.

Since the late 1800s, tidal gauges indicate that mean global sea level has \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_; there
is consensus among scientists that sea level \_\_\_\_\_\_.

options.A: decreased by about 5 centimeters (2 inches); will soon begin to rise.
options.B: remained constant; may begin to rise if glaciers melt.
options.C: increased by about 5 centimeters (2 inches); will continue to rise.
options.D: increased by about 20 centimeters (8 inches); will continue to rise.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - increased by about 20 centimeters (8 inches); will continue to rise.

questions.stem_text: When did the florescence of Ancestral Puebloan culture occur?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - just after A.D. 1000

questions.stem_text:
What is believed to be the reason for the development of a complex society at Caral in
South America?

options.A: the need to collect large quantities of shellfish
options.B: the construction of canals for irrigation
options.C: the building of the Piramide Mayor
options.D: the excavating work to produce the sunken plazas

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the construction of canals for irrigation
